newsitem.title: USA: 3 Vermont towns get community development grants.
newsitem.headline: 3 Vermont towns get community development grants.

text.p: More than $1 million in community development block grants were doled out by Gov. Howard Dean this week.
The largest grant went to Waterbury for $490,000 to improve storm sewers, and a loan to Green Mountain Coffee Roasters for an expansion that will create 40 new jobs.
Wells River will get $313,000 to create affordable housing in three historic downtown buildings.
Waitsfield will get $120,000 to renovate a 138-year-old schoolhouse into a senior citizens' center.
